reading: The renovation of Telekom's customer service as one path of eight numbered steps with a measure for each: 1 measure first; 2 works agreement; 3 choose suppliers; 4 train staff; 5 one customer record for account changes (logged-in reads can start sooner); 6 permissions in stages (read, then undoable actions, then changes fraud could use); 7 acceptance; 8 run it. A separate note: no dismissals for business reasons until 31 December 2028, for about 60,000 staff under the collective agreements; about 4,000 positions a year leave by agreed routes. No dates or durations are drawn: the path shows order only.
headline: The renovation, in order
orderWhy: The text gives an order and a measure for each step, but no dates or durations; the figure draws none.
